parsed_json.up: Select distinct chembl_id from molecule_dictionary, compound_name from compound_records, and canonical_smiles from compound_structures for molecules linked to document CHEMBL4433236. Join docs filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4433236' to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, then inner join compound_structures on molregno to enforce that canonical_smiles is present. Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
